package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for json_marshal_then_write: `data, _ := json.Marshal(v); w.Write(data)` when `json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)` would stream directly
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
type Item struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Price int    `json:"price"`
}

func itemsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	items := []Item{{Name: "widget", Price: 10}, {Name: "gadget", Price: 25}}
	data, err := json.Marshal(items)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write(data)
}
